scenarios.criterion: The seed data MUST contain exactly the three shop-owned expeditions in seed.seededExpeditions, and adventurers Elara and Borin MUST exist as users with the expeditions seed.adventurers assigns them.
scenarios.name: Seed data contains the three shop expeditions and the two adventurers' own expeditions
given: The mock API's data files hold the expeditions-api seed and have not been hand-edited
when: The expeditions and users seed data are loaded
then: Exactly three expeditions owned by the shop are present: Spring to Crag (Moonwell Spring to Ember Crag), Glade to Caves (Thornveil Glade to Glimmerdeep Caves), and Cairn to Shoals (Saltmarsh Cairn to Tidewrack Shoals)
A user named Elara exists and owns an expedition from Moonwell Spring to Frostcap Hollow
A user named Borin exists and owns an expedition from Ember Crag to Saltmarsh Cairn

scenarios.criterion: GET /api/expeditions with no session MUST return exactly the three seeded expeditions (spec AC3).
scenarios.name: An anonymous visitor sees only the shop's seeded expeditions
given: No Authorization header is sent with the request
then: The response contains exactly the three seeded shop expeditions
No adventurer-owned expedition appears in the response

scenarios.criterion: GET /api/expeditions with Elara's session MUST return the seeded expeditions plus Elara's own, and MUST NOT ever return Borin's (spec AC4). This is the trust boundary the security gate checks.
scenarios.name: Elara sees the seeded expeditions plus her own, and never sees Borin's
given: Elara is signed in with a valid session
then: The response contains the three seeded shop expeditions
The response contains Elara's own expedition from Moonwell Spring to Frostcap Hollow
The response does not contain Borin's expedition from Ember Crag to Saltmarsh Cairn

scenarios.criterion: POST /api/expeditions with a session and a line whose two endpoints are at least 1 km apart on Aurelis (sphere, radius 6,000 km) MUST store the expedition for the session's adventurer, never an owner the request body supplies, and the stored expedition MUST then be returned by GET (spec AC11).
scenarios.name: A signed-in adventurer's new expedition is stored under their own identity, never a forged owner from the request body
given: An adventurer is signed in with a valid session
The submitted line's two endpoints are at least 1 km apart on Aurelis
The request body also supplies a different owner or userId field
then: The expedition is stored under the signed-in adventurer's own identity, not the owner supplied in the body
A subsequent GET /api/expeditions by the same adventurer includes the newly stored expedition

scenarios.criterion: POST /api/expeditions with no session MUST be refused with 401 and MUST NOT store anything (spec AC12).
scenarios.name: An anonymous visitor cannot create an expedition
given: No Authorization header is sent with the request
when: The visitor submits POST /api/expeditions with an otherwise valid line

scenarios.criterion: POST /api/expeditions with endpoints less than 1 km apart MUST be refused with 422 naming a zero-length line, and MUST NOT store anything (spec AC13).
scenarios.name: An expedition whose endpoints are less than 1 km apart is refused as a zero-length line
given: An adventurer is signed in with a valid session
The submitted line's two endpoints are less than 1 km apart on Aurelis
then: The error names a zero-length line

scenarios.criterion: Tests MUST run through node:test via the mock-api's existing `test` script (node --test, added by reagent-sites-api) and MUST leave the repository unchanged: running the suite twice MUST show no git status change, including under apps/mock-api/data/. POST writes to a data file, as registering a user does, so tests MUST isolate or restore what they write.
scenarios.name: Running the expeditions test suite twice leaves the repository unchanged
given: The mock API's node:test suite, including the expeditions tests, has been run once already
when: The suite is run a second time via the existing `test` script
then: git status shows no changes under apps/mock-api/data/ or anywhere else in the repository after either run

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths (apps/mock-api/**, docs/features/expeditions-api/**) MUST change.
scenarios.name: The implementation stays within its complexity budget, test-coverage bar, and file scope
when: The changed code is reviewed for complexity, coverage, and file scope
then: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
Every changed line is covered by a test that fails if the behavior it checks is broken
No file outside apps/mock-api/** or docs/features/expeditions-api/** has been modified
